label: v115
changes: New: Family Recipe Book — snap a photo of a recipe card (or dictate it in chat) and it's filed automatically, or add one by hand
New: Travel Timeline — add a travel photo and it auto-detects the country from the photo's location and builds a trip timeline
New: Birthday Timelapse — add one photo per birthday and watch a growing-up video, built right in your browser
New: tap the calendar icon on a profile to see that person's own upcoming dates (passport expiry, check-ups, and more) in one list
Creating a business now offers to pre-fill the name and details it can find from your existing chat, instead of a blank form
